title: Announce store doc overclaims rollback resistance vs whole-volume snapshot restore
description: announce_store.rs module doc claims separate state/floor roots mean 'a rollback snapshot cannot silently rewind both sides'. True only for single-root rollback or crash windows; an attacker who restores a same-volume snapshot predating an IID's first accept() rewinds BOTH roots, load() returns Ok(None), and accept() silently TOFU-pins whatever key arrives. Options: persist a monotonic generation marker in a third root so (None,None) with a marker present fails closed, and/or correct the doc to state the TOFU-inherent limit. Found by security codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-12zy.
